description: This source file provides utility functions for handling vendor-specific TLV (Type-Length-Value) messages in a multi-vendor environment. Specifically, it includes an example function demonstrating how to add a vendor-specific TLV to a CMDU message, with logging and error handling.

classes.name: tlvf_vendor_example_utils
classes.description: Namespace containing utility functions for vendor-specific TLV handling, including the example for adding a vendor-specific TLV.

methods.name: bool add_vendor_example_tlv(ieee1905_1::CmduMessageTx & cmdu_tx)
methods.description: Adds a vendor-specific TLV to a given CMDU message. Currently, it logs an informational message and returns true without modifying the message as an example implementation.
